posts.author: Adam
posts.title: Random Ban & Admin breaking NLR
posts.html:
hey!

i was playing on your server 10 minutes ago and found a unlocked car. I decided to steal the car and boost through the city (i like being wanted by cops xD). An admin came and made me wanted, i didnt have any problem with that but when the cops accidently killed me instead of arrest me the admin called  ||VM|| Lexi  got angry and teleported me to cops and made me wanted again (breaking nlr!). I ran away from cops when they tried to arrest me and got away, the admin then banned me for an hour :S ...strange?

I can deal with the hour but dont want to have that kind of admin in this great server..

- Adam

posts.author: Lexi
posts.title: Re: Random Ban & Admin breaking NLR
posts.html: yeah, that was me. You were teleported back because there was a glitch when you were arrested because I grabbed you with the physgun, he arrested you and it teleported you back to the same spot, then he unarrested you by accident. Therefore, teleporting you straight back and re-warranting you was perfectly acceptable, and you responding how you did was unacceptable. Be glad it was only an hour.
